cues: Its uses run far and wide.
Penicillin and citric acid from fermenters.
Microbes that eat oil spills, plants that pull lead out of soil, the glucose meter, bacteria that leach copper from ore, and Spirulina as protein.

text: Its uses run far and wide. Penicillin and citric acid from fermenters. Immobilised enzymes. Ethanol and biodiesel. Microbes that eat oil spills, plants that pull lead out of soil, the glucose meter, bacteria that leach copper from ore, and Spirulina as protein. And one Nepal knows well: biogas.
